# WB14 · Điều phối lịch · đã xếp hết danh sách chờ

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · state · Next.js: **built (U2)** (`/schedule`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#schedule`
- Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
- `operations-ui.js › schedule()`: the side panel "Chờ xếp lịch" shows the empty text "Đã xếp hết danh sách chờ." once `o.waitlist` is empty. Each of the six cards was booked through "Xếp lịch →" (`ops=wait`), which opens the booking dialog with `data-wait` and removes the waiting entry on save.
- The stat tiles show the demo day: "Lịch trong ngày" 31, "Chờ xếp lịch" 0 (the six bookings were made on 2026-12-01, not on the demo day).
- Inventory note: The six waiting-list cards were each booked through "Xếp lịch →" on an empty future day (room and doctor chosen to fit the service); the side panel then reads "Đã xếp hết danh sách chờ.". Browser-local data only.
- Page key `schedule` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.

Kit components used: Button×5, Tile×4, Field×3, Card×2, PageHeading×1, Badge×1, EmptyState×1; shared pieces: FilterChip×1, Notice×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

- Đã lưu lịch và cập nhật Patient 360
- Đã xếp hết danh sách chờ. (empty state)

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "Đã lưu lịch và cập nhật Patient 360"
- Empty text "Đã xếp hết danh sách chờ." (with the final full stop).

## Differences from the app design
- App I3 does not draw a waiting list; the panel "Chờ xếp lịch" and its empty state are old-web only.
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in I3: "Đã lưu lịch và cập nhật Patient 360"

## Gotchas
- The demo day is fixed: 2026-09-20 09:00 (`DAY` in `operations-data.js` and `crm-automation.js`). Dates before that day cannot be booked.
- The last booking leaves the toast "Đã lưu lịch và cập nhật Patient 360" in the snapshot (a toast lives 2800 ms; the snapshot is inside that window and was identical on two runs).
